# Passport client

`passport-client.mjs` is the unmodified `@szlk/passport-client` 0.1.0 ES module from `jobssteve164dev/SZLKPassport`, commit `c6733e5dbeaf1d0f14f0993f8d11f27c3e86ec4d`, `packages/passport-client/index.js`.

The upstream package is private and is not distributed through npm. This source snapshot keeps SoloDrop on the published Passport SDK contract while bundling it into the Worker. Keep protocol changes in the upstream SDK and replace this snapshot with a reviewed upstream version.

SHA-256: `1f0a5ed7eb49d5116769948587e0c9b0651d47812ad78d1ee72f1a51305b9e84`.
